Imagine waking up before the alarm — clear-headed, steady, actually ready for the day.

That kind of morning starts the night before. And in midlife, rest doesn't always come the way it used to. Shifting cortisol rhythms and a warmer core body temperature can quietly interrupt the deep stages your body leans on to feel restored. The good news: small, intentional changes can make a real difference.

The Midlife Sleep Fix is a guided workbook designed to help you build an evening you look forward to — a calming wind-down routine, simple light and temperature adjustments, and journaling prompts to quiet a busy mind before bed. Gentle, sustainable habits you can genuinely keep.

And right now it comes with the Energy Restoration Guide included free — a $68 value together, yours for $39. A thoughtful way to invest in the rest you've earned.

You've given so much of yourself for so long. Better nights are one of the kindest things you can give back.
